entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: Embeddable SDK that powers video carousels and feeds on partner websites and apps, enabling native short-form video experiences.

entities.name: Genuin Ad Ops Guide - MCC Edition
entities.description: Confidential McClatchy-edition reference guide (March 2026) covering activation, configuration, and management of all in-stream and in-feed ad formats on the Genuin platform.

entities.name: Brand Control Center
entities.description: Genuin's operational console used by partner brands to configure and manage ad placements and sponsored content workflows.

entities.name: Aniview
entities.description: Third-party ad server used to render in-stream pre/mid/post-roll programmatic ads within the Genuin Video Player via VAST.

entities.name: Genuin Video Player
entities.description: Player that renders Genuin video content and supports VAST-based programmatic in-stream ads.

entities.name: In-Stream Ads
entities.description: Programmatic ads that play inside the video player as pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll spots.

entities.name: In-Feed Ads
entities.description: Card-format ads that appear within the scrollable video feed alongside organic content.

entities.name: In-Feed Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: In-feed ad placement that occupies the first five feed slots for a sponsoring brand.

entities.name: Onsite Placements
entities.description: Deployment model where the Genuin SDK is embedded on a partner site/app and a backend-driven feed serves dynamic content supporting both in-stream and in-feed ads.

entities.name: Offsite Placements
entities.description: Deployment model using standard IAB banner slots (300x250, 300x600) on external pages, running preset video collections in a Genuin-powered player; supports in-stream playback only.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: Video Ad Serving Template standard used by the Genuin Video Player to render programmatic in-stream ads via Aniview.

entities.name: IAB Banner Slots
entities.description: Standard IAB banner sizes (300x250 and 300x600) used for Offsite Genuin placements on external pages.

entities.name: McClatchy
entities.description: Publisher partner for which this March 2026 confidential edition of the Genuin Ad Ops Guide was prepared.

entities.name: Partner Brands
entities.description: Publishers, retailers, and media companies that embed Genuin video experiences and activate ad formats on their websites and apps.

entities.name: Programmatic Advertising
entities.description: Monetization channel through which Genuin sells in-stream pre/mid/post-roll inventory, rendered via Aniview and VAST.

entities.name: Direct Sponsored Content
entities.description: Workflow for creating and managing directly-sold sponsored content placements as part of Genuin's layered monetization model.

relationships.source: Genuin Ad Ops Guide - MCC Edition
relationships.description: The guide is the McClatchy-specific edition prepared for the publisher partner.

relationships.source: Genuin Ad Ops Guide - MCC Edition
relationships.description: The guide documents workflows for Genuin's Brand Control Center.

relationships.source: Genuin Ad Ops Guide - MCC Edition
relationships.description: The guide documents the Aniview ad server workflow used for in-stream ads.

relationships.source: Genuin Ad Ops Guide - MCC Edition
relationships.description: The guide is the definitive reference for activating and managing in-stream ads.

relationships.source: Genuin Ad Ops Guide - MCC Edition
relationships.description: The guide is the definitive reference for activating and managing in-feed ads.
The SDK is embedded by partner publishers, retailers, and media companies on their sites and apps.
Onsite deployments embed the Genuin SDK directly on partner websites and apps.
Onsite placements support in-stream pre/mid/post-roll ad formats.
Onsite placements support all in-feed ad types.
Offsite placements run inside standard IAB banner slots on external pages.
Offsite placements support direct in-stream video playback within the banner.
In-stream ads render inside the Genuin Video Player.
In-stream pre/mid/post-roll ads are served programmatically via the Aniview ad server.
The Genuin Video Player uses the VAST standard to render programmatic ad responses.
Sponsored Takeover is an in-feed ad format occupying the first five feed slots.
In-stream pre/mid/post-roll inventory is sold programmatically.
BCC is the console used by partner brands to configure ad placements and sponsored content.
Direct sponsored content creation is managed through the Brand Control Center workflows.
